listing.title: Dental Practice Manager Excel Template, Recall Planner, Treatment Plans, Insurance Claims, Lab Work, Invoices, 15 Languages
listing.headline: The dental practice spreadsheet built around recalls, plans and claims
listing.description:
Dental Practice Manager is an Excel workbook built for a small dental clinic: recalls, treatment plans, insurance claims, lab work, materials, appointments, invoices and payments in one file. Every total is a formula on your own data.

MADE FOR DENTISTS
- Recall planner: each patient gets a next check-up date from your interval; choose a month to see who is due, the chair hours and the revenue.
- WhatsApp links: recall due, appointment reminder, balance reminder, plan follow-up and lab work back, filled with the patient's details.
- Treatment plans by phase (urgent, restore, replace, cosmetic), priced from your list, with accepted work waiting past its date in red.
- Insurance claims: claimed, approved, received and still owed; claims waiting longer than your chase days turn red.
- Insurance split calculator: what the insurer and the patient pay after deductible, coverage and annual maximum.
- Lab work: sent, due back, days late and lab cost. Materials: stock below its minimum shows the quantity and cost to order.
- Chair utilisation: hours open, booked and free over 7 days, and what one more chair or longer hours would give.

THE DAILY WORK
Patients with medical alerts and balance, appointments with chair time, a price list with codes, visits, invoices with tax and status, payments and expenses. A dashboard with 16 numbers and a month-by-month chart. Printable invoice, treatment plan, patient statement, consent form and attendance certificate. Checklists for a new patient and a lab case.

15 LANGUAGES
English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Chinese and Indonesian; Arabic, Persian and Urdu open right-to-left.

YOU RECEIVE
A ZIP with 15 .xlsx files and an English copy filled with sample data. Works with Excel 2019, 2021, 365 and LibreOffice. No macros. The consent wording is a sample to check against your local rules.
